summary: Five focused commits under the operator's 'continue with the feature logic ... double-check each time ... look over your shoulder ... execute like a professional' directive. Phase 2.6a (witness co-signing via manual envelope-JSON exchange) at 88a7c89, Phase 2.6b (custody handoff for the grandchild thread) at a036a27, Phase 2.7 (generic attachments — photos + documents with renamed claim schema) at 9e7ab4b, idle-timeout hook (DESIGN.md §5, default 30 min, configurable in Settings, closes the mid-session-abandonment window Phase 2.5 widened by exposing passphrase in context) at 076327c, anchor-worker polish (30s fetch timeout via wrapped OtsTransport + AbortController, exponential backoff for failed rows: min(5min × 2^attempts, 1hr)) at 3889fc4. Branch and main both at 3889fc4. All four root gates green on every commit; tapit-attest 74/74 active unchanged.

why.text: Operator gave a sustained autonomous-work directive with strict discipline: continue feature logic, verify each step, library-seam audit, adversarial diff read pre-push. Treated the directive as license to keep cutting until the immediate Phase 2.x feature surface plus the highest-priority security and lifecycle polish items were all done. Multi-tab worker coordination, HEIC/WebP photo re-encode, pre-commit library-seam audit script, OTS fixture restoration, Tap-it-Attest-main.zip cleanup, and the Phase 3 inter-app pathway remain queued. None block the operator's grandchild-scenario shippability; all are documented in carpenter-state-for-foreman.

files_changed: Five commits, ~35 files net across the block including 8 new files (cosigning feature + idle-lock hook). Plus one comms-refresh commit (38727c8) at the midpoint.
outcome.tests_passing: root 16/16 on every commit; tapit-attest 74/74 active + 4 skipped unchanged.
outcome.notes: Library-seam audit clean on every commit — wallet code consumes envelopeId, canonicalEnvelope, signEnvelope-via-wallet.sign, verifyEnvelope, assertWellFormed, metaAttestation, OpenTimestampsProvider with custom transport injection. Two mid-session bugs caught pre-push by adversarial diff review: phantom useWalletIdentity helper reference (Phase 2.6b) and missing idleTimeoutMs in initial Prefs state (idle-timeout). Both fixed in their landing commits. Keys-never-leave audit re-confirmed across the block: signing always local via wallet.sign, only public envelopes cross via copy-paste in cosigning, encrypted blobs through storage, passphrase still in WalletContext but now bounded by the idle-lock timer that re-prompts after 30 min (configurable). Bundle posture: login surface unchanged ~110KB gzipped; HomeScreen lazy chunk ~4.6KB gz, JournalDetail ~4.2KB gz, attest chunk ~25.8KB gz, all within healthy budgets but trending monotonic (bundle-budget audit logged as pre-Phase-3 follow-up).

uncertainty: End-to-end against a real Netlify+Supabase deploy still pending the operator's wire-up work. Specific new validation paths for this block: copy-paste flow between two real devices for witness co-signing, custody-handoff round-trip (operator signs → new custodian signs back → operator absorbs), document-attachment picker on iOS and Android, idle timer firing after 30 min of inactivity, anchor worker fetch-timeout behavior under deliberately-slow network conditions. The pieces compose from gate-verified primitives, so the risk profile is integration-level not code-level.
next: Pausing at a natural stop point. The operator's immediate Phase 2.x feature surface plus the highest-priority security and lifecycle polish items are complete. Six follow-ups remain logged: multi-tab worker coordination (BroadcastChannel), HEIC/WebP photo re-encode, pre-commit library-seam audit script, bundle-budget audit, OTS fixture restoration, Tap-it-Attest-main.zip cleanup. Phase 3 (inter-app deeplink or Nostr NIP-46) is the next meaningful feature cut but it is a bigger scope step that deserves an explicit greenlight rather than autonomous initiation. PLAN.md is now out of date with the actual phase ordering (Phase 2.5/2.6/2.7 not represented) — minor housekeeping for a future session.
